span.text: A diary entry: the porter said this note corrects SHIP-7 in full, but nobody wrote it down.
Ref. Letter No. 41 is hereby corrected: ten bales, not twelve.

Message-ID: RATES-1849
Subject: Freight rates for 1849
Status: retired
Flour travels at two cents a barrel per mile.

Message-ID: SHIP-7
Subject: Flour shipment to Albany
From: Boston flour office
To: Albany depot
Date sent: May 12, 1850
Cargo: forty barrels of flour
Forty barrels of flour left Boston for the Albany depot on the morning boat.

Message-ID: SHIP-8
Subject: Count correction for SHIP-7
From: Boston flour office
Date sent: May 14, 1850
Correction to SHIP-7: the cargo count changes only to thirty-eight barrels; the destination remains unchanged.

Message-ID: SHIP-9
Subject: Wool shipment
From: Salem wool house
Date sent: May 20, 1850
Twenty bales of wool left Salem.

Message-ID: SHIP-9
Subject: Wool shipment
From: Salem wool house
Date sent: May 20, 1850
Twenty-two bales of wool left Salem.
